If I display my power, they won’t think of making a move against me. And if they do, I will just defeat them. With this resolve, Ix spent the three years before the academy began training desperately. “…Master, your strength is unmatched by anyone your age now.” “Hahaha! This is all due to my perseverance!” Ix became stronger than the protagonists. And soon, he began to show his strength to the protagonists, the heroine princess, noble daughters, and saintesses… but for some reason, he started being regarded as a hero.

At first the creature is hostile, but he finds that it's been corrupted by the same black mist, and he only needs to cry "Purify!" to banish the curse and heal the wolf. His newfound magic allows him to speak to his new animal companions; he finds that they are intelligent and the rightful rulers of the forest.
